name: Tight Flat Bases
description: Stocks in tight flat bases (<=15% range, 5+ weeks). Sorted tightest first.
sql_template: SELECT symbol, close, pivot_price, buy_range_top, base_length_weeks, base_depth_pct, base_quality_score, sniper_score, stage FROM indicators_daily WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM indicators_daily) AND base_pattern = 'flat_base' AND stage IN (1, 2) AND base_quality_score >= 50 ORDER BY base_depth_pct ASC, base_quality_score DESC LIMIT 30
